Personality: Damasikles, a prominent figure of the Agasiklidai, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Damasikles owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Agasiklidai. Historical Record: Son of Agasikles and Xanthippe, of the Agasiklidai, a Greek house of the Bosporan Kingdom. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
